name: cc-gg-bridgy
description: Provider switch for the Claude Code extension: Anthropic ⇄ any Anthropic-compatible endpoint (z.ai GLM, Kimi, …) via named env profiles, per project, busy-gated — plus one-command beam of the active session to your phone via Remote Control

commands.title: CC-GG-bridgy: Switch provider for this project (Claude ⇄ GLM ⇄ …)
CC-GG-bridgy: Configure Claude Code process wrapper
CC-GG-bridgy: Beam session to phone (Remote Control)

ccGgBridgy.quietWindowMs.description: Transcript must be silent this long before a session counts as idle.

ccGgBridgy.switchToast.description: Show the post-switch notification with the [New conversation] shortcut. Off: the status-bar label change is the only confirmation.

ccGgBridgy.restartCliOnSwitch.description: After a provider switch, end this window's idle Claude Code CLI process so the next conversation respawns under the new provider (model list updates without a window reload). Only processes backing THIS workspace's open conversations defer; others die immediately. Queued processes die when their conversation closes (no 'exited' banner).

ccGgBridgy.anthropicLiveUsage.description: Read LIVE Anthropic usage by refreshing the Claude Code OAuth token from the macOS Keychain (opt-in; off by default). The statusline feed only updates from terminal sessions — enabling this polls the usage endpoint directly, so the bar stays fresh in the panel too. Falls back to the statusline feed on any failure. macOS only.
